# LJ Web Management

> LJ Web Management builds custom, done-for-you AI automation systems that remove repetitive tasks and bottlenecks, connecting the business tools a team already uses so people can save time and focus on growth.

LJ Web Management is based in Lockport, Illinois, and works with businesses across 57+ industries. Rather than selling off-the-shelf software, the company scopes and builds automations tailored to a client's specific role, tools, and workflow, then delivers a flat, upfront quote before any work begins. The catalog covers 1000+ pre-scoped, done-for-you automations organized by industry and job role (real estate, healthcare, legal, home services, restaurants, e-commerce, and dozens more), alongside larger platform-scale solutions for businesses that need more than a single automation.

## Who this is for

- **Business owners and executives** evaluating how to implement AI in their business: LJ Web Management scopes, builds, and supports the automation, so leadership gets the outcome (time saved, costs cut, faster response) without needing an in-house AI or engineering team.
- **Employees and individual contributors** looking to supplement their own work with AI: the automations remove the repetitive parts of a role so the person keeps doing the judgment-based work that AI can't, which is increasingly the work that keeps a role valuable as more of a job becomes automatable.

## Automations by Business Function

- [Lead Follow-Up & Sales](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/lead-follow-up-sales/): Respond to every lead in minutes, chase quotes automatically, and keep deals from going quiet. (127 automations)
- [Marketing & Customer Retention](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/marketing-retention/): Win back lapsed customers, reward loyalty, and keep repeat business coming in on its own. (143 automations)
- [Scheduling, Reminders & Dispatch](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/scheduling-dispatch/): Fill calendars, cut no-shows, backfill cancellations, and route crews without phone tag. (101 automations)
- [Customer Service & Communication](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/customer-communication/): Proactive status updates, faster support routing, and far fewer "just checking in" calls. (113 automations)
- [Reviews, Feedback & Reputation](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/reviews-feedback/): Ask every customer for a review at the right moment, fix problems fast, and watch your reputation. (46 automations)
- [Billing, Payments & Finance](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/billing-finance/): Invoices that send themselves, payment reminders that get paid, and books that close on time. (69 automations)
- [Client Onboarding & Intake](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/onboarding-intake/): Turn a signed deal into a smooth start with forms, documents, welcome sequences, and kickoff. (38 automations)
- [HR, Hiring & Team Management](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/hr-team/): Hire faster, onboard consistently, and keep certifications, shifts, and timesheets on track. (54 automations)
- [Compliance, Documents & Deadlines](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/compliance-documents/): Track licenses, permits, contracts, signatures, and filing deadlines before they become problems. (122 automations)
- [Operations, Inventory & Vendors](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/operations-inventory/): Keep stock, equipment, vendors, projects, and work orders moving without the spreadsheet chase. (138 automations)
- [Reporting & Analytics](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/automations/category/reporting-analytics/): Dashboards, digests, and alerts that show leaders what is happening without anyone building a report. (49 automations)

## Guides

- [What Should You Automate First? A 5-Factor Scoring Framework](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/what-to-automate-first/): A simple way to score every repetitive task in your business and pick the automation that will pay off fastest, with a worksheet you can use today.
- [How to Automate Lead Follow-Up: A Speed-to-Lead Playbook](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/automate-lead-follow-up/): Respond to every new lead in minutes, follow up until they answer, and hand hot leads to a person at the right moment. A practical playbook with message templates.
- [Missed-Call Text-Back: How It Works and How to Set It Up](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/missed-call-text-back/): Every unanswered call is a customer about to dial your competitor. Here is how missed-call text-back works, what to say, and how to set it up the right way.
- [How to Reduce No-Shows With Automated Appointment Reminders](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/reduce-no-shows-appointment-reminders/): A practical reminder schedule, message templates, and the waitlist and rebooking automations that keep your calendar full when people still cancel.
- [How to Automate Invoicing and Payment Reminders (and Get Paid Faster)](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/automate-invoicing-payment-reminders/): Send invoices the moment work is done, follow up on unpaid balances without awkward calls, and recover failed card payments automatically.
- [How to Automate Review Requests Without Annoying Customers](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/automate-review-requests/): Get more reviews by asking every customer at the right moment, with the right link, while staying inside Google's review policies. Timing, templates, and setup.
- [Client Onboarding Automation: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/client-onboarding-automation/): Turn a signed deal into a smooth start: automated intake forms, document collection, welcome sequences, and kickoff scheduling that every client experiences the same way.
- [Employee Onboarding Automation: A Checklist for Small Teams](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/employee-onboarding-automation/): Automate offer-to-first-day paperwork, account setup, training assignments, and check-ins so every new hire gets a consistent start, even without an HR department.
- [CRM Automation: How to Keep Your Pipeline Clean Without Manual Data Entry](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/crm-automation/): The CRM automations that matter most: lead capture, routing, deduplication, activity logging, stage updates, and stalled-deal alerts, plus how to roll them out.
- [How to Calculate the ROI of Business Automation](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/automation-roi/): A simple, honest method for estimating what an automation will save and earn, including the costs people forget, with worked examples and a payback calculation.
- [Zapier vs. Make vs. n8n: How to Choose an Automation Platform](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n/): An honest comparison of the three most popular workflow automation platforms for small businesses: how they work, how they charge, and which one fits your situation.
- [AI Agents vs. Workflow Automation: What Small Businesses Should Know](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/guides/ai-agents-vs-workflow-automation/): What AI agents actually are, how they differ from rule-based workflow automation, where each one shines, and how to combine them safely in a small business.
- [What Is Business Automation? A Plain-Language Guide](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/resources/what-is-business-automation/): What business automation is, how it works, and how it's different from AI automation and RPA, with examples and next steps for implementing it.
- [50+ Business Automation Examples by Department & Industry](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/resources/business-automation-examples/): Real business automation examples across sales, marketing, operations, support, finance, and HR, plus examples by industry to spark ideas for your team.
- [AI Automation for Small Business: Getting Started Without an IT Team](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/resources/ai-automation-for-small-business/): How a small business can start using AI automation without an in-house IT team, what it costs, and which automations to build first.

## Full detail

- [llms-full.txt](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/llms-full.txt): Extended reference with every business function, industry, and integration in the catalog, the solution descriptions, and the full FAQ, in plain text for AI systems and answer engines.
- [/crawl](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/crawl/): Plain-text rendering of llms-full.txt for AI crawlers that request a specific crawl path.
- [openapi.json](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI description of this site's read-only reference endpoints (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, sitemap.xml, /crawl/, /faq/, /automations/).
- [/.well-known/ai-plugin.json](https://www.ljwebmanagement.com/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): AI tool manifest pointing to the OpenAPI description above.
